source: lab (captured; this copy is a SAM2 segmentation: background replaced by flat green, face masked green, watermark 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' bottom-right x>=1030,y>=690)
units: pixels and seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.motion: static (no background exists, but the three static objects stay fixed: basketball centre std 0.04/0.08 px over 49 frames; bin and shoe std 1-5 px only from occlusion by person/ball)

intrinsics_from_benchmark_convention.note: f = 0.5959 x 1280 (80 deg HFOV Orbbec Femto Mega)

camera.perspective_cues: Camera looks forward and somewhat down at the floor; objects lower in the image are closer. Floor objects: bin (~y 589 base), shoe (y~687 bottom), basketball (bottom cut at y 719). No visible floor plane/horizon (background removed). The exercise ball rolls toward the camera and to the left; its apparent diameter grows 130 -> ~207 px (frames 0 -> 32) and it leaves through the bottom-left image edge.

exercise_ball.description: large dark-grey gym/exercise ball with light specular highlights; the only grey sphere
exercise_ball.reference_point: centre of least-squares circle fitted to the ball's free silhouette edge (cx, cy); diam = circle diameter
exercise_ball.notes: Frames 0-19 held against the person's body/hands (left edge and bottom free). Frames 33-44 cut by the bottom image edge; circle fit from the upper arc only, and the SAM mask is flattened/irregular there, so cx,cy,diam less reliable (diam can be off by 10-30%).

person.description: person in black clothes with long dark hair, face masked green, crouching behind the ball, left of the blue bin; pushes the ball with both hands then stays crouched
person.reference_point: centroid of the visible person mask (cx, cy); lower body partly hidden by ball (frames 0-28) and bin (all frames); bottom limited by y=585 (bin top/feet)
person.notes: Crouching the whole clip; never stands. Visible mask height ~214-242 px (head top y 344-374 to y~585). Arms flung outward/upward after release (frames 22-30).

recycling_bin.description: blue plastic recycling bin with white recycling symbol and yellow stickers, right of the person
recycling_bin.notes: top rim y~486 (rim is an ellipse seen from above), base y~589; the person's arm overlaps its left top in some frames

basketball.description: orange-brown basketball on the floor at the bottom centre-right
basketball.height_px: 96 (cut by bottom image edge at y=719; true diameter ~92 px from width)
basketball.notes: bottom few px may be cut by the frame edge; use width 92 px as its apparent diameter

shoe.description: single white sneaker with black stripes (Adidas-like) on the floor at bottom-left, toe pointing up-right
shoe.visible_frames: 0-35 and 42-48 (36-41 hidden behind the rolling exercise ball; partly hidden 35, 42-44)

events.event: ball at rest held by the person (cx 617, cy 507, diam 130)
person begins to rise/lean forward (head top y 374 -> 354 by frame 14); ball only jitters +-4 px
push starts: ball centre begins to move steadily down-left (start of ball motion, +-1 frame)
release: hands leave the ball (arms swing outward); ball still brushing the person's knees until ~frame 26
ball clearly separated from the person
ball bottom reaches the bottom image edge (partially out of frame from here)
ball passes in front of the shoe (shoe hidden 36-41)
last frame with the ball visible (small sliver bottom-left); gone from frame 45
